name: ApexX Racing ChampionShip By Winter Art

reviews.review_description:
Absolute garbage, cant grab steering wheel and when you can the car is all over the place, needs serious work, and you cant get your money back, 
Tried what was said and updated, it grips but keeps letting go steering is terrible when you do grip it, review stays as it is.
Driving mechanics are horrible.  Can't even grab the steering wheel at times.  Was looking forward to playing, so disappointed.  Meta how do you allow this on your store?

developer_response.body: Thank you for your feedback, and we're sorry for the frustrating experience. We’ve updated the game to fix the steering wheel grabbing issue. Please download the latest updated version and give it another try. We hope you enjoy the improved experience. If possible, we’d really appreciate it if you could update your review based on the latest version. Thank you for your support!
